# BobTech plus Angel gameplay fixture

This private F210 fixture uses the exact BobTech plus Angel Smelting closure recovered
from the published 4.7.2 evidence. Before it accelerates any research, its data stage
checks the three admitted families and all five generated rows against the independently
captured item, recipe, owner, science, prerequisite, progression, and effect facts.

The runtime fixture seeds only the seven named direct external prerequisites. A real
lab completes Tin levels 1–3, Gunmetal levels 1–3 plus continuation level 4, and Invar
levels 1–3 plus continuation level 4. It checks native productivity (+6% to both Tin
routes and +8% to the Gunmetal/Invar routes), consumes 11 automation, 8 logistic, and
2 space packs, saves, and observes the same state on two cold reloads.

This is a bounded candidate gameplay witness. It does not claim ordinary tuning,
unrelated Angel materials, foreign-force behavior, multiplayer behavior, performance,
or release qualification.
